title: Home
body: BxRig BxRig brings an opinionated, beautiful and efficient desktop to Linux, built for developers. It turns a fresh CachyOS or Arch install into a finished developer rig: Hyprland with Noctalia (KDE Plasma stays installed beside it), BoxLang and MatchBox, your apps, your shell, your AI agents, all chosen in one guided setup. It is a single native program written in BoxLang and compiled with MatchB…

title: The wizard program
body: The setup wizard The BxRig setup wizard: a full-screen terminal form written in BoxLang on MatchBox's terminal canvas ( docs/tui.md in the MatchBox repo). title: Security
body: Security Releases are signed. CI signs each channel's version-latest.properties and install.sh with an Ed25519 key. The public key is built into the program and into the published installer. The installer and bxrig update verify the signature and the SHA-256 of every file they download; any mismatch stops before anything changes. title: Mail catcher
body: Mail catcher When you build an app that sends email, you want to see the mail without sending it to anyone. bxrig mail runs a catcher in a container ( Mailpit ): your app sends to 127.0.0.1:1025 and the mail shows up in an inbox. Nothing leaves your machine. bxrig mail start --yes # plan first without --yes bxrig mail env # the settings to put in your app bxrig mail test # send one sample message …
